Our Culture

A culture that empowers

We’re a startup company, scaling at pace. We take great pride in our exceptional technological advancements and are equally proud of the talented team we have assembled to drive this success.

  • Professionals

    We strive for excellence in everything we do, which includes producing high-quality software that makes our customers secure.

  • Team Work

    We are more than just individual contributors. We enjoy collaboration and working together to help raise each other up.

  • Personal Development

    We invest in our employees and empower them to push their own limits to learn new skills.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology

    We are striving toward innovation. Our advanced technology gives our employees the tools to secure software supply chains.

  • Transparency

    We value open communication across the entire organization so that our teams feel connected and informed.

  • Diversity and Inclusion

    We believe a diverse and inclusive company is a strong company, and we work hard to foster a supportive workplace for everyone.
